# The positions tools/csharp-reference/MpComms.cs gives CommsNTRIP to send as GGA, and
# crates/mp-transport/tests/csharp_goldens.rs gives the Rust. `<lat> <lng> <alt>`; a line starting
# `#` is a comment.
#
# ArduPilot SITL's home, Canberra: south and east.
-35.363261 149.165230 584.0
# North and west, with a negative altitude.
51.477928 -0.001545 -45.5
# Minutes and altitudes on a rounding tie in the second decimal, as far as .NET's 15 digits see.
10.5000833333333 20.5000833333333 0.125
10.5000083333333 20.5000083333333 2.675
10.1234567 20.7654321 1.005
# One axis zero is still a position.
0 45.5 10
45.5 0 10
# Just either side of zero.
-0.5 -0.25 -0.004
0.0001 0.0001 0.005
# The ends of the earth.
89.999999 179.999999 8848.86
-89.999999 -179.999999 -430.5
# Whole degrees, and a degree less a hair.
1 2 3
0.99999999 1.99999999 3
